findings.root_cause: Fixed120-second initial checkpoint timeout was too short for full QA; killing only parent shell could leave committing children.
findings.changes: Checkpoint900s and smoke1800s defaults, explicit1..7200s budgets; process-group timeout/interruption cleanup with bounded drain/reap, signal policy restored; actual timeout/resume checks retain all QA.
findings.regression: Slow runner, real timeout/no delayed commit, retry success, nested outer timeout, SIGINT/SIGTERM, detached pipe drain, invalid budget refusals.
findings.residual_limit: SIGKILL cannot be caught; a malicious process can detach into a separate session. This is supervised local execution, not OS security isolation.

findings.root_cause: No-Git export walked generated __pycache__ as release content after ordinary Python execution.
findings.changes: Manifest-backed source exports validate source hashes and permit only unlisted current-interpreter bytecode with exact compile/marshal equivalence to unchanged hash-verified inventoried source; never unmarshal or execute caches. Actual ZIP --archive scan inspects every member and rejects runtime artifacts regardless of source-cache exception.
findings.regression: Clean and post-test exports; tracked/inventoried/archived bytecode and nested secrets rejected; altered/missing inventory sources, symlinks/traversal and corrupt ZIP fail.
findings.residual_limit: Inventory is not authenticated supplier provenance; heuristics cannot certify secret absence.
